text:
A frontline tank who charges into battle and protects allies.

Primary: CON | Secondary: STR

MP mechanic: MP charges from taking damage - activate Lancer's Shield to convert MP into a damage-absorbing barrier at 2.25x rate.

Skills:
Bastion's Charge - rush + stun, gains range/damage/knockaside as it levels
Lancer's Leash - pull 6 mobs
Challenging Shout - aggro all screen, gains resolve/taunt immunity/AoE weaken as it levels
Iron Cairn - earth eruption, grows into a lingering battlefield-control zone as it levels
Valkor's Aegis - hurl your shield through enemies, heals on return
Shield Thrust - damage + knockback, requires shield
Iron Reprisal - timed counter: negate and return the next hit
Pivot Strike - reposition behind an enemy and strike
Stacia's Bulwark - temporary invulnerability, grows stronger as it levels
Stacia's Cleansing Light - strip your own debuffs
Lancer's Shield - MP damage barrier
Iron Will - CON-based self heal, doubled while shield active

Passives:
Bastion's Retribution - reflect damage scaled by AC
Guardian's Resolve - defense scales with nearby enemy count
Hold the Line - enemies hitting nearby allies gain threat toward you instead
